title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account and application preferences
name: Name
readOnly: Read-only. Admin access is required to edit.
pricingReadOnly: (read-only. Only an administrator can change this)
adminOnly: Only an administrator can change this
calendarHint: Dates across the dashboard. Ethiopian calendar is expected by Amharic-speaking staff.
languageHint: Follows you between terminals. Emails and SMS use this locale too.
notificationsHint: Choose channels, quiet hours, and whether alerts wait for a digest.
quietHoursHint: Inbox still fills. Email, SMS, and push pause until morning.
digestHint: Bundle email into a summary instead of sending each alert immediately.
pushEnabled: This browser will alert you to unassigned rides with the tab in the background.
pushUnavailable: Web push is not configured on the server (missing VAPID keys).
pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in this browser.
staleSettings: Settings were updated elsewhere. Reload to see the latest.
hintPerKm: Added for every kilometre of the trip.
hintCurrency: ISO code shown on every receipt and payout.
hintCommission: Applied to new drivers. Existing rates stay until you apply to fleet.
hintStaleDriver: Drop online drivers with no GPS after this.
hintMinCoupon: Drivers at or below this cannot take new rides.
hintStartingCoupons: Granted when a driver is created.
hintPerRide: Deducted automatically when a driver ends a trip.
hintOperatorLow: Inventory level at which an operator is prompted to restock.
hintDriverRequest: Drivers can request coupons from the app.
farePreview: A 5 km, 12-minute trip costs {fare} {currency} ({base} base + {perKm} × 5 km + {timeCharge} × {blocks} time {blockWord}{raised}).
applyCommissionTitle: Apply default commission to every driver?
applyCommissionBody: This overwrites each driver's current rate with {percent}%. Existing custom rates cannot be restored automatically.
enforceRadiusHint: Off: city-wide, still capped by max drivers.
dispatchPreviewTitle: What happens on the next ride
dispatchRingEnforce: the closest {max} eligible drivers within {radius} km (expanding to {expanded} km, then city-wide, if the ring is empty)
dispatchPreview: The next ride is offered to {ring}. Drivers have {ttl} seconds to accept. ETAs assume {speed} km/h when routing is unavailable. Online drivers silent for {stale} minutes are dropped.
deductCommission: {percent}% of the fare is deducted as commission from the driver's wallet.{gate}
deductBoth: {count} coupon(s) plus {percent}% of the fare are deducted from the driver's wallet.{gate}
deductFlat: {count} coupon(s) are deducted from the driver's wallet.{gate}
gateBlocked: Drivers below {threshold} coupons cannot accept a new ride.
gateOpen: Drivers are not blocked from accepting when underfunded.
savedDispatch: System settings saved. Dispatch and fares pick them up within 30 seconds
needWrite: You need settings:write to change these
currencyIsoError: Currency must be a 3-letter ISO code (e.g. ETB)
passwordPolicyHint: New passwords cannot match any of your last 5. Shared terminals also idle-timeout after the Super Admin's policy.
fillPasswords: Fill in your current and new password
passwordMismatch: New password and confirmation do not match
twoFactorHint: Protects your account with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, etc.) in addition to your password.
enterSixDigit: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
scanQr: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enterCodeConfirm: 2. Enter the 6-digit code it shows below to confirm.
backupCodesHint: Backup codes. Save these somewhere safe:
signOutOthersFailed: Could not sign out other sessions
require2faHint: They enrol at the next sign-in before the dashboard opens.
idleTimeoutHint: 7-day sessions stay, but a quiet terminal signs itself out.
